name: Should I remodel an existing room or build an in-law suite addition for an aging parent?

mainEntity.name: Should I remodel an existing room or build an in-law suite addition for an aging parent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting an existing room updates your current footprint, while adding an in-law suite or accessory dwelling unit builds new square footage. Remodeling an existing master bath or ground-floor bedroom costs less and preserves yard space, but you must work within existing structural dimensions and plumbing lines. An addition provides complete freedom to design zero-threshold entries, wide hallways, and customized living quarters from scratch, though it requires exterior foundation work, permitting, and a larger budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remodeling an existing room is faster and less costly, while an addition allows you to build completely custom, barrier-free living quarters from scratch.
